neighbours.label: Consequence continuations introduced by 'so' or 'therefore', and resultative 'making X Y' phrases.
fire: Our shipment arrived early, so today we can finish assembling the display.
The old boots pinched my toes, so these wider ones suit me better.
The lake froze overnight, so the ferry service has been suspended until further notice.
The sauce already contains salted butter, so a small pinch of seasoning should suffice.
The samples came from different sites; therefore, each container needs a separate identification tag.
The defendant never received the notice; therefore, this hearing must be postponed.
The renovation doubled the floor space, making the library a comfortable venue for community meetings.
The update eliminates repeated database queries, making the application a faster tool for daily reporting.
quiet: Today we can finish assembling the display, and our shipment arrived early.
These wider boots suit me better, and the old ones pinched my toes.
Until further notice the ferry service remains suspended, and the lake froze overnight.
A small pinch of seasoning should suffice; the sauce already contains salted butter.
Each container needs a separate identification tag, and the samples came from different sites.
This hearing must be postponed; the defendant never received the notice.
The library offers a comfortable venue for community meetings, and the renovation doubled its floor space.
For daily reporting the application offers a faster tool, and the update eliminates repeated database queries.
